annotation.title_clean: Directive 2005/64/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council of 26 October 2005 on the type-approval of motor vehicles with regard to their reusability, recyclability and recoverability and amending Council Directive 70/156/EEC
annotation.title_en: Directive 2005/64/EC on the type-approval of motor vehicles with regard to their reusability, recyclability and recoverability and amending Council Directive 70/156/EEC
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 310
annotation.summary_en: EU Directive 2005/64/EC sets type-approval requirements for M1 and N1 motor vehicles on reusability, recyclability and recoverability (85% and 95% by mass), amending Directive 70/156/EEC. It requires manufacturer assessment, certificates of compliance, and bans reuse of certain safety parts. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: M1 and N1 vehicles must be reusable/recyclable to at least 85% and reusable/recoverable to at least 95% by mass
Type-approval granted only after a competent body assesses the manufacturer and issues a certificate of compliance, valid at least two years
Safety-critical parts such as airbags and seat belts must not be reused in new vehicles
Non-compliant types are refused approval from 15 December 2008, and new vehicles are refused registration from 15 July 2010
